liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Listener identifies this as the best Dark Star they have heard; The performance is described as dripping with teases [7][9][10]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The segue into I Know You Rider is called amazing [12]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Listener claims this is the best version they have ever heard [14]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The version is unique and features a jazzed-out style [12]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Garcia's vocals on this track are described as beautiful [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-18.126123.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 36 songs; 207 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd73-12-18.sbd.hamilton.12214.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 184 min; rated 4.46/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Audio is generally fine despite a few minor mess ups; Sound quality is excellent and the band plays tightly together; A reel flip in the recording is a crucial flaw [9][10][11]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.hamilton.clevenger.fix-12214.12469.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 184 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.hamilton.3119.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 184 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.miller.97511.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min; rated 4.39/5 by 23 [7]. Said about its sound: Disc changes are seamless, though patches are not perfect [7]

## Around the show

- Bobby tells a psychedelic story between songs in the first set [10]
- Jerry ate Wheaties that day, and Donna was nowhere to be found [14]
- Phil teases the Other One fiercely after the MLB jam [16]
- This show is considered superior to the December 19, 1973 performance [12]
- The China to Rider jam is less tight than the Cleveland show [13]
- The show is average for the time but has sudden jumps [15]
- This Mind Left Body Jam is a unique mid-tempo blues rhythm [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-18.126123.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by dusborne and Droncit; source: 3 source matrix: Soundboard (shnid 97511); AdamG's audience recording (new flat transfer); and Dan McDonald's audience recording (new flat transfer) [1]
- **gd73-12-18.sbd.hamilton.12214.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.hamilton.clevenger.fix-12214.12469.shnf**: transferred by Greg Hamilton and Bob Clevenger; source: Reel master > cassette > DAT > CDR [3]. Also: Bob Clevenger taped the show, with a reel change in Wharf Rat [3]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.hamilton.3119.shnf**: transferred by unknown; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: True provenance is unknown due to a misplaced info file for an alternate set [4]
- **gd1973-12-18.sbd.miller.97511.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [7]. Also: Recorded from the 12th row using Shure and AKG microphones to cassette [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Curtis Hixon - December, 1973](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/curtis-hixon-december-1973) [28]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Curtis Hixon - December, 1973](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/curtis-hixon-december-1973) [29]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1973-12-18 Tue Curtis Hixon Convention Hall, Tampa, FL](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1338012169390/grateful-dead-1973-12-18-tue-curtis) [30]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 58: Curtis Hixon Hall, Tampa, FL 12/18/73](https://store.dead.net/products/daves-picks-vol-58-curtis-hixon-hall-tampa-fl-12-18-73) [31]
